name: World Super Holdings Limited
summary: World Super Holdings Limited, established in 2016 and headquartered in North Point, Hong Kong, is an investment holding company that leases heavy construction equipment, including crawler cranes, oscillators, piling machines and trench cutters, in Hong Kong, Uzbekistan, China and Macau. It also trades new and used machinery and parts, delivers equipment, runs construction projects such as groundwork, operates an e-commerce platform and provides money lending.
